verdict.rationale: Airwallex's docs cover CLI, MCP, webhooks, and skills for building automations, but there is no evidence of version control, review workflows, or rollback capabilities for automations/workflows themselves (e.g., no changelog, versioning API, or undo mechanism for AgentOS skills or CLI-scripted workflows). missing for 10: any versioning system for automations, review/approval workflow tooling, rollback/undo mechanism for executed multi-step workflows.
